themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents capable of performing complex research tasks, automating workflows, and acting autonomously in research contexts.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, reviewing, and debugging code, aiming to improve productivity and code quality.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI applications designed to aid researchers in data analysis, literature review, and knowledge discovery.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores how AI is directly applied to UX/UI design processes, from concept generation and system design to user interface enhancements.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the behavior, capabilities, limitations, and user interactions with AI-powered chatbots.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI affects jobs, employment, skill requirements, and the overall labor market, including research on AI's role in job displacement and creation.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Deals with AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, data, or research findings into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Focuses on comparing, reviewing, and assessing the effectiveness and utility of various AI tools for specific tasks.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Covers the use of AI to extract actionable insights from customer data, feedback, and behavior.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of artificial or simulated users for testing and research purposes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
